The '''Republic Special Forces Division''', simply known as the '''Republic Special Forces''', was an elite military division comprised of the best [[Republic trooper]]s recruited from within the ranks of the [[Republic Army]]. They were charged with aiding the defense of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Harron Tavus]] was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the RSF during the Great Galactic War.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Republic_Spec_Forces.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Republic Vanguard]]
The Special Forces troops wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] similar to the standard [[Republic trooper]], but sometimes on occasions they wore heavier variants made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] that were specialized armor for elite status. Overall, however, the [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|Clone paratrooper]] helmet used by the Republic some 4,000 years later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] seems to most resemble this type of headgear.

==History==
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] was instrumental in the formation and training of the Republic Special Forces, and served as their commander during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War. These elite troopers would sometimes cooperate with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], such as Lieutenant [[Harron Tavus]] who often partnered with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]. The two worked closely together during the Great War and developed a friendship during the war. In some parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], they constituted the only military available.

By [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Tavus led hundreds of SpecForce operatives to defect to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Garza tried to keep the defections secret, possibly not to lower morale, while dispatching a new [[Havoc Squad]] to take down and kill the traitors.
